name: Countess Charlotte Brabantina of Nassau
contribution: The fifth daughter of William the Silent and his third wife, Charlotte of Bourbon.

checks.lead: Countess Charlotte Brabantina of Nassau (Antwerp, 17 September 1580 – Château-Renard, August 1631) was the fifth daughter of William the Silent and his third wife, Charlotte of Bourbon.  She lived in her life at the French royal court and performed many successful assignments as a mediator.
